description: Root structural defect behind FIND-901: the harness resolves 'the ledger' INDEPENDENTLY of the recorder. record-earn.mjs is the single source of truth for the ledger location (record-earn.mjs:24, prod-pinned to $FOUNDER_DIR/state/earn-ledger.jsonl), yet founder-loop.sh:13 computes its own LEDGER from a separate env-var precedence and the goal-check at line 26 sums over THAT path. Two independent path resolutions for the same money artifact = a divergence surface: any future change to one (env precedence, default, FOUNDER_TEST behavior) silently desynchronizes the goal-check from the actual ledger. The harness should depend on the recorder's resolution, not duplicate it. Secondary hardening note (not independently blocking): line 27 `case ... *[!0-9.]*` admits malformed numerics like `1.2.3` which then make `awk "BEGIN{exit !($TOTAL>0)}"` (line 28) error to STATUS=NO — fail-safe direction (never inflates), but TOTAL should be validated as a single well-formed number, and the jq sum (line 26) silently coerces a non-numeric earn_usdc to 0 via `.earn_usdc // 0` which masks a corrupt ledger row rather than surfacing rc!=0.
fix: Make the recorder the single source of the ledger path (e.g. have record-earn print its resolved LEDGER path, or share a single resolver), so the harness never independently re-derives it. Separately, validate TOTAL against a strict numeric regex (e.g. case match on a single optional-decimal number) and consider treating a non-numeric earn_usdc in the ledger as a fail (rc!=0) rather than silently `// 0`.
